text: {"lessons":["Doing nothing through a prolonged decline is still a decision; I should periodically reassess each holding and my overall risk rather than let reluctance to sell dictate my choices.","A few months of gains or losses do not reliably signal what comes next, so I should base trades on a clear plan instead of reacting to recent performance.","Frequent account checks can make ordinary fluctuations feel urgent; I should set deliberate review points and trade only when my assessment or risk limits justify it."]}
